confirmed_pairing: Same-label SET precedes RESET on the same physical device; no missing-cycle history is reconstructed.

predeclared_comparisons.constant: For each left-out cycle, geometric mean peak current of the other13 cycles, minimizing their log squared error.
predeclared_comparisons.one_variable: Fit log10(Ipeak/A)=a log10(G_SET/S)+b on13 other cycles; use only the left-out SET50mV read as its predictor.
predeclared_comparisons.fixed_peak_voltage: Predict Ipeak=G_SET times median Vpeak of the other13 cycles; no multiplicative coefficient fitted.
predeclared_comparisons.conditional_decomposition: Ipeak versus G_SET times its own observed RESET Vpeak; descriptive only, not prior-phase prediction.

feature_definitions.SET_G: |I|/|V| at the single native nonlimited SET return50mV sample.
feature_definitions.RESET_origin_slope: sum(|V| |I|)/sum(V^2) over outward50..200mV; seven native points.
feature_definitions.RESET_intercept_slope: OLS slope/intercept of |I| on |V| over the same seven points; descriptive observations, not a cycle-specific physical model.
feature_definitions.RESET_peak: Largest current magnitude on the outward branch, first native index on ties; endpoint maxima would be retained.
feature_definitions.SET_switch: First outward crossing0.995mA; midpoint of previous/native-crossing voltages, with the full native bracket retained.
feature_definitions.RESET_tail: Native return−0.2V current magnitude; no interpolation or noise subtraction.

logG_SET_vs_logRESET_origin_slope.scope: Same14-record association; no independent mechanism test.

logG_SET_vs_logRESET_intercept_slope.scope: Same14-record association; no independent mechanism test.

logG_SET_vs_logIpeak.scope: Same14-record association; no independent mechanism test.

logG_SET_vs_logVpeak.scope: Same14-record association; no independent mechanism test.

full_sample_logG_to_logIpeak_linear_desc.scope: Two global descriptive coefficients on the same14 records; not independent validation or per-cycle physics parameters.

conditional_Gset_Vpeak_decomposition.meaning: Conditional amplitude decomposition with observed outcome-phase Vpeak; never compared as a prospective predictor.

instrument_and_sampling_observations.scope: No RESET compliance or range metadata was supplied. Above10mA observations do not justify inventing a10mA limit, dropping cycles or labeling peaks as artifacts. Native peak neighborhood/near-peak ambiguity is preserved.
instrument_and_sampling_observations.zero_and_0p025V_RESET_points: Excluded from descriptive low-bias slopes; not used to infer offset correction.
instrument_and_sampling_observations.raw_sign_scope: RESET currents are stored positive at negative voltage; all signs retained in provenance, comparisons use magnitudes rather than imposing a signed-Ohmic convention.

scope: Only original14 training labels accessed; no holdout or new electrical model simulation.
LOO uses13 other cycles which may occur later in time. It is internal cross-validation, not a chronological future-cycle test or independent external validation.
Cycles of one device are not established IID samples; n=14 is small. No p-value, confidence interval, feature search, outlier deletion, or mechanism selection by statistical significance.

Within-cycle prior-phase G_SET is valid input before RESET; its strong low-voltage association supports carrying a conductance-related state, but does not identify its microscopic origin or the minimum dynamical state dimension.
Measured Vpeak is future RESET information. Its conditional decomposition residual must never be described as achieved prior-phase prediction accuracy.
RESET slope fits and fold-wise statistical regressions are measurement summaries/prediction diagnostics, not per-cycle material-parameter fitting.
